name: thalius-hippocampus
description: Turns your company's documents into an expert your AI consults: an LLM-built wiki that answers complex questions across many files, quoting the source of truth with page and link, in a small context. Includes a skill that picks the cheapest tool for each question.

capabilities: Answer complex questions across many documents
Quote the exact passage with its page and a link
Read exact text or a page range
Find documents by name or recent change
Add notes and files to the workspace
defaultPrompt: What does our employee handbook say about remote work? Quote the passage and its page.
Compare the termination clauses in our supplier contracts and quote each one with its page.
Save these meeting notes to /Meetings in Hippocampus.

positive.description: A free overview of the workspace before any search
positive.prompt: What's in our Hippocampus knowledge base?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls start once and lists the top folders with one line each. Spends no credits and does not search.

positive.description: A cited answer from one document
positive.prompt: What is the notice period in our supplier agreement? Quote it.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the exact sentence from the supplier agreement, names the document and the page, and gives the link that opens the passage. Does not invent a period that the document does not state.

positive.description: Browsing a folder without spending credits
positive.prompt: Open the Policies folder and list what's in it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls open on /Policies and lists the documents with one line each. No search, no credits.

positive.prompt: Which of our documents changed in the last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find for the most recently changed documents and lists them with their changed time. No search, no credits.

positive.description: Keeping a decision for the team
positive.prompt: Save these meeting notes to /Meetings in Hippocampus: Decision: the launch moves to 3 March. Owner: Anna.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the notes as a Markdown document in /Meetings (on a connection made read-only, the person is first asked to allow adding documents), follows the import and reports the new document's address and who can read it.

negative.description: A general question that is not about company documents
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Stockholm tomorrow?

negative.description: Creative writing with no company material
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: A calculation that needs no company documents

publication.release_notes: 0.2.2: two prompts (ask, overview), a usage guide, a server card that directories can read before sign-in, and neutral credit wording in every result.
